items.title: An injective hull of the residue field satisfies the descending chain condition
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that an injective hull of the residue field of a Noetherian local ring satisfies the descending chain condition (author lemma at source lines 1101-1106, label lemma-injective-hull-has-dcc). The proof (source lines 1108-1124) turns a descending chain of submodules into a chain of restriction surjections of hom modules into the hull, uses that the endomorphism ring of the hull is the Noetherian completion to stop that chain, and rules out a proper inclusion by exhibiting a nonzero element killed by the maximal ideal in the quotient, which would give a nonzero map into the hull (proof lines 1117-1123). The stabilization and the final contradiction are the substance. H3.
